levels.1: Network play received a later rollback update.

levels.1: The remaster bundles earlier add-ons.

levels.1: Hundreds of clears share one file.
levels.2: Hundreds of clears share one file; verify it before creating completion data.

levels.1: Combo timing depends on the capture chain.
levels.2: Combo timing depends on the capture chain; verify it before creating completion data.

levels.1: Complete every universal lesson.
levels.2: Complete every universal lesson; open its local menu.
levels.3: Clear the full Lesson list, repeating failed inputs until every row carries its completion mark.

levels.1: Exercise every system toggle.
levels.2: Exercise every system toggle; open its local menu.
levels.3: Demonstrate recording, playback, counter-hit, guard, recovery, SP, Burst, Awakening, Shadow Frenzy, Persona break, status, and damage settings.

levels.1: Every normal and Shadow type has a command page.
levels.2: Every normal and Shadow type has a command page; open its local menu.
levels.3: Open each available command list and perform every normal, special, super, awakening, burst or frenzy, throw, and Instant Kill that the selected type supports.

levels.1: Local play can verify most unlocks safely.
levels.2: Local play can verify most unlocks safely; open its local menu.
levels.3: Use every stage, both player sides, all 22 normal fighters, all 15 Shadow types, Boss Mode where unlocked, and every owned color and glasses option.

levels.1: Saved battles form a finite local media record.
levels.2: Saved battles form a finite local media record; open its local menu.
levels.3: Save, rename, play, seek, pause, and delete a test replay, then retain one representative replay for each major mode.

point_of_no_return.title: Keep the pre-choice chapter save
point_of_no_return.why: Both chapter paths must be recorded before the final continuation.
point_of_no_return.detail: Do not overwrite the branch until story completion reaches 100 percent.

levels.1: Begin with the bundled predecessor campaign.
levels.2: Open P4A Story Mode and preserve its branch bookmarks.
levels.3: Complete every predecessor viewpoint and alternate ending, revisit temporary stops after their continuations unlock, and verify the P4A selector reaches 100 percent before starting the Ultimax chapters.

levels.1: The first Ultimax episode opens the parallel record.
levels.2: Finish the first episode through its initial completion state.
levels.3: Clear every Episode P4 chapter and visible branch, preserve the final chapter save, and return to the episode selector only after Episode P3 becomes selectable.

levels.1: The parallel episode changes the final branch.
levels.2: Preserve a branch save at Chapter 10 of the parallel episode.
levels.3: Finish every Episode P3 chapter, keep the Chapter 10 save, play the first answer until its scene records, reload, then play the second answer until that branch also records.

levels.1: Two completed perspectives unlock a return path.
levels.2: Return to the first episode after both perspectives are complete.
levels.3: After both episodes and both Chapter 10 answers are recorded, reopen Episode P4, follow its newly available continuation, and verify the combined story percentage reaches 100 percent.

levels.1: The remaster includes a separate perspective episode.
levels.2: Open the included additional episode after the main perspectives.
levels.3: When the separate episode becomes selectable, finish every chapter and branch, then return to its selector and verify each chapter carries a clear mark.
